evidence: Clicked Add Entry, filled Task Name/Priority/Due Date/Completed/Notes, submitted; new row "QA Test Entry 42 Dec 25, 2026 This is a test note" appeared, entry count went from 5 to 6.
Configure Fields dialog shows existing fields with types Text, Number, Date, Checkbox; added a new field "Notes" with type Text via the new-field form and it appeared as a new column immediately.

Added entry with Task Name="QA Test Entry" (text), Priority=42 (number), Due Date=2026-12-25 (date), Completed=Yes (checkbox), Notes="This is a test note" (text); all values saved and displayed correctly in the table row.

issue: Missing required-field validation on Add Entry
actual: Clicked "Add Entry" then immediately clicked the submit "Add Entry" button without filling Task Name or Notes (leaving them blank/undefined). The entry was still created and added to the table (entries count went from 5 to 6) with an empty Task Name and empty Notes, instead of being blocked.
Clicked the delete (trash) icon button on a table row once; the row was deleted immediately (entries count went 6 to 5) with no confirmation dialog or button shown beforehand.

evidence: Inspected DOM: unchecked cells render a gray "X" icon (lucide-x text-muted-foreground), checked cells render a green "check" icon (lucide-check text-success) — visually distinguishable.

Clicked "Cards" button; layout switched from table rows to a grid of cards, each showing Task Name as heading and Priority/Due Date/Completed/Notes as labeled fields. Clicking "Table" (verified later) returns to table layout.

All 6 entries with all 5 fields (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) are fully displayed in both table view (row/column cells) and card view (labeled field rows within each card), including the newly added "QA Test Entry" with Notes "This is a test note".

Table view shows distinct column headers per field (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) each with a sort button. Card view shows each field as a labeled row with a distinct icon per field type (number/calendar/checkbox/text icons) next to the value.

Clicked Sort > Priority in card view: entries reordered ascending (1,1,2,2,3,42). Clicking Priority again toggled to descending (42,3,2,2,1,1). Status text updated to "Sorted by Priority (ascending/descending)".

issue: No dedicated filter feature to display entries by specified field criteria
actual: Inspected the entire UI (banner, toolbar, column headers, DOM for inputs/selects/buttons with "filter" in label or content) and found no filter control besides the free-text "Search entries..." box (already tested as IX-17) and per-column Sort buttons. There is no way to specify structured criteria (e.g., Completed = Yes, Priority > 2, date range) to filter entries.

evidence: With sort cleared, focused the drag handle of "Update API documentation" (3rd row), pressed Space to pick up, ArrowUp twice, Space to drop. Row order changed from [Design, Review, Update, Prepare, Team, QA] to [Update, Design, Review, Prepare, Team, QA] — exactly matching the 2-position upward move performed.

Priority field is a native input[type=number]. Playwright's fill() threw "Cannot type text into input[type=number]" for value "abc". Pressing the "a" key while focused left the value unchanged at "0". Typing "7" correctly set the value to "7".

Due Date field is a native input[type=date]. Setting value to invalid dates "2026-13-45" and "2026-02-30" both resulted in the input value being rejected (empty string), while a valid date "2026-02-28" was accepted and set correctly.

After sorting by Priority ascending/descending and after manual drag reordering, all field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) for every entry remained identical to before the operation — e.g. "QA Test Entry / 42 / Dec 25, 2026 / Yes / This is a test note" unchanged across all reorder operations; entry count stayed at 6 throughout.

issue: No filter feature exists to verify accuracy against
actual: Same root cause as FT-6: there is no dedicated filter-by-criteria mechanism in the app (only free-text search and sort). Since no filter feature exists, its accuracy/data-safety requirement cannot be met.

evidence: Typed "landing" into Search entries box: table instantly filtered to the single matching row "Design new landing page" and footer showed "1 entry matching \"landing\"". Typed "test note" (text only present in a Notes field): correctly filtered to "QA Test Entry" row, showing search works across fields, not just Task Name. Clearing search restored all 6 entries.

Clicking Sort > Priority immediately reordered entries and updated the footer status to "Sorted by Priority (ascending)" with no perceptible delay; clicking again for descending updated instantly as well.
